title: finding(app-shell): an interface list page drops its source view's `hiddenFields` and `fieldOrder` — `InterfaceListPage` hand-projects `listViews[sourceView]` and carries neither
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site (class a): two declared per-view keys that are authored and served but never reach the list on this page. It is the objectui#7516 class on a different door. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the contract review of PR objectui#10622 (objectui#7516, merged `41ecaedc`), which found it out of scope and noted it. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main` at `651632062`)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx`:
- `resolveSourceView` (~:56) resolves `listViews[cfg.sourceView]` (or the object's `list`).
- The page then hand-projects that view's keys into the list schema: `view.filter` (~:435), `view.columns` (~:445), `view.sort` (~:449).
- `hiddenFields` and `fieldOrder` have **0** mentions in the file.

Lit control: after PR objectui#10622, app-shell `ObjectView`'s `renderListView` relays both keys (`hiddenFields: viewDef.hiddenFields ?? …`, `fieldOrder: viewDef.fieldOrder ?? …`, ~:2687 / ~:2704). The spec declares both on the list view (objectstack#15184 ruling B wrote the `columns` × `hiddenFields` × `fieldOrder` composition into the contract), and `ListView`'s `effectiveFields` reads both.

⇒ An interface page whose `sourceView` authors `hiddenFields` or `fieldOrder` shows every column in `columns` order. This is read from source, not measured through a render.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Carry both keys from the source view into the page's list schema, with the page config's precedence stated. Mirror the objectui#7516 relay pin. Check whether the page's `cfg` has its own spelling of either key that should win.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T21:20Z):
- `InterfaceListPage … hiddenFields|fieldOrder` ⇒ 0.
- `sourceView … hiddenFields|fieldOrder` ⇒ 0.
- Lit control: `InterfaceListPage` ⇒ 11 hits.

Dedupe words: `InterfaceListPage sourceView hiddenFields` · `interface page fieldOrder dropped` · `interface list page per-view columns order`
